##### Source: Player's Handbook (Divine Favor)

*1st-level altercation*

**Casting Time:** 1 bonus action

**Range:** Self

**Components:** V, S

**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute

Your bond empowers you with neon energy. Until the tech ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 neon damage on a hit.

***Tech Lists.*** [Enforcer](/techs:enforcer)
